.

​A heated exchange over a controversial election promise descended into a mass brawl in Armenia's parliament on Wednesday, with lawmakers from the ruling party and the opposition trading punches and kicks in a clash broadcast live. 

​The incident took place on Thursday during a debate on the election of a member of the Audit Chamber, after ruling Civil Contract party MP Taron Chakhoyan referred to a pre-election remark by a relative of opposition leader Narek Karapetyan.
